turns.userMessage:
Build a Greek temple: a stepped stylobate base about 16x10 studs, a colonnade of at least 6 round columns per long side (freestanding, evenly spaced), an inner cella wall, an entablature beam ring resting on the columns, and a low-pitch pediment roof with triangular gable ends. Sand or white scheme. 120-260 parts.
Constraints: footprint must fit within 18x12 studs; height at least 168 LDU (7 bricks); use at least 100 parts.
